name: Necromancer Summoning Prodigy keeps Skeletal Archers 3 sec longer (#1353)
contract: Summoning Prodigy 704682 is an Animation talent (CharacterAdvancement 33774, ClassType 25 = class 23, Tab Animation, TalentEssenceCost 1, SpellFamilyName 29) whose description reads 'Increases the duration of Skeletal Archers by $/1000;s1 sec.' Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) MiscValue 1 (SPELLMOD_DURATION), BasePoints 2999 + DieSides 1 = +3000 ms, EffectSpellClassMask (0, 0, 0x400000) in family 29, which matches the archer summon 500330 (family flags 8, 0, 0x400000; SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON of three creature 50076, DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms). The learned ability Animate: Skeletal Archer 805040 (CharacterAdvancement 7345, description 'Animate ${$500330m1} Skeletal Archers to aid you in combat for $500330d.') triggers 500330. A native summon applies the caster's SPELLMOD_DURATION to the summon spell's duration (Spell::EffectSummonType), so the archers must live 15 sec without the talent and 18 sec with it: 16 sec after they appear none remain without the talent and all three remain with it, and they are gone within the following 3 sec.

steps.label: CONTROL: without the talent the archers are gone after 16 sec
SETUP: the native duration modifier adds 3000 ms to the archer summon
SETUP: three Skeletal Archers appear again
Outlast the 15 sec base duration again
DISCRIMINATING: with the talent all archers remain after 16 sec
